quest_template.QuestDescription:
'So while we're waiting here, maybe you could fetch us up some grub. Them tauren were runnin low on meats, so I'm sure they'd be thankful to have more.

I hear that musken ribs are the specialty here.  The wild musken here are too lean for any good meat, but across the river there are some nice fat ones. Maybe you should check those out!

Don't worry, I'm pretty sure there aren't any dragons over there...'

'Care to help settle a bet, chum?

Those tauren are Skyhorn, and they fancy themselves big-time hunters. I bet them a pretty penny that they wouldn't be able to take out some of the biggest beasts in Stormheim.

If you take em out before they do, I'll split the wager. Deal?

The first is a big eagle nesting in the foothills. They call him Spitefeather. You can bait him with some meat, but he's up pretty high, so you'll need a grapple gun to get there. I think there's one of them layin around here...'

'The second target is a basilisk called Stonefang that lives off the bank of the nearby river. 

I put a bigger wager on him, so if you can take him out I'll make sure you get a cut.

I'll need his jaw to verify the kill. Hurry, before those tauren get him first!'
